render verbose, normal, or summary windows inside one additive read-only Conversation View

assertions.expected: The exact hosted package and Cordis entry occur once; every declared DeepSeek peer resolves to 0.1.2-alpha.2 and no removed aggregate runtime resolves.
A cold Web start reaches __DSH_BOOT_READY__; exactly one additive Conversation View entry and eight reversible locale dictionaries are present.

A direct click selects Verbose (all loaded previews), Normal (the six most recent), or Summary (the most recent) inside the plugin View; the choice stays only in the mounted React state and resets when the View closes or unloads.

Fixed Chat target fixtures update through ChatSnapshot.navigation.items() from uiConversation.binding(sessionId).target('chat') without reading transcript markup, reconstructing event history, or changing the official Chat owner.

The adaptation uses only official Slots, Conversation target binding, Chat navigation, and Locale contracts; it has no raw DOM, official Chat mutation, root/sidebar replacement, Remote, route, outbound request, credential, process, file, or browser-persistence capability.

The semantic heading, list, status text, and mode buttons inherit official theme and font styles; buttons remain keyboard operable with a programmatic pressed state and content remains readable in narrow layouts, 200 percent zoom, 12/14/17 pixel font settings, and light and dark schemes.

Removal leaves zero Conversation View entries, locale dictionaries, mounted React state, package rows, client graph entries, or dependency-closure changes, and governed Home and Profile bytes match the snapshot.

The uniquely identified additive View coexists with official Chat, trajectory, root, sidebar, settings, todo, and goal surfaces; full-batch rollback restores all prior entries after an injected later failure.
